messages:
amy: Quick proposal — shrink the weekly triage from 30 → 25 minutes and require a short pre-read for any issue we want to discuss. Thinking: add a `triage-pre` label and a 5-item pre-read template so we spend the meeting on decisions, not context. Pilot next Wed 09:30. Thoughts?

jon: Sounds reasonable. Can we reserve the last 5 minutes for hotfix/urgent items that pop up during the week? Also how do we handle owner absence if the assigned person can't make it?

priya: +1 on the pre-read. I can run the pilot next Wed. For owner absence, maybe auto-fallback to oncall or the rotation lead if no owner confirms 2h before triage.

sam: Quick pre-read template suggestion — small code block folks can paste into issue: 

```
PRE-READ:
- One-line summary:
- Impact (P0/P1/P2):
- Repro steps / link:
- Suggested owner:
- Quick mitigation / rollback plan:
```

amy: Love the template, sam. Let's add a short `Regressions?` line to that checklist. Proposal for owner absence rule: if an issue has `triage-pre` and no assignee 2h before, post a ping to oncall and move the issue to a "pre-read queued" board column.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: #eng triage pilot — Wed 09:30 — reminder 2 hours before.

jon: One small nit — 25 minutes might still be tight depending on volume. Could we try 25 for the first 2 sprints and re-evaluate metrics (avg items discussed, carryover)? :thinking_face:

priya: Happy to timebox items strictly. We can use a timer in the calendar invite and track carryover as a metric.

amy: OK — plan: 25-minute pilot for two sprints, mandatory `triage-pre` for items to be discussed, fallback -> oncall if no owner, `triage-pre` label + "pre-read queued" column. Pilot starts next Wed 09:30. I've added the label and column. Sam, can you update the calendar invite + set the timer/reminder?

sam: Will update invite, add a 2h reminder and a 15s countdown timer at meeting start. I also added the `triage-pre` checklist to the triage board template. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

amy: Thanks — I'll post the pilot note in #eng and link the pre-read checklist. If anyone wants to opt-out of running the pilot, ping me privately.

priya: I'll collect a quick retrospective after sprint 2 and share metrics (avg items, carryover %) so we can decide whether to keep 25 or adjust.

sam: Done — calendar updated. See you Wed.
